feeds.title: Notes D'Art Brut
feeds.description: Lucienne Peiry is an art historian, PhD, specialist in Art Brut, curator, speaker and essayist. She held the position of director of the Collection de l'Art Brut, in Lausanne, for ten years (2001-2011) and promoted the enrichment and influence of the museum in Switzerland and abroad. She carried out research and discovered new authors of Art Brut in the world in order to enrich the museum's collections, to study and publish works and documentary.

feeds.title: Atelier Herz der Kunst
feeds.description: Tine Klein was born in Dortmund, lives in Zurich. She works with everything that she can always have with her or can find on the go. Art should be expressive. Art should be fun and be so easy that she can always be there, this is what Tine teaches in her painting courses.

feeds.title: Antonio Wehrli Art Space Blog
feeds.description: Antonio Wehrli is a Swiss artist based in China and Switzerland. Read articles on and about his arts, gallery, exhibition, and more.

feeds.title: FATart Blog
feeds.description: The Femme Artist Table (FATart) is the only organization in Switzerland that is so committed to the concerns of women in the art market. Find out more about FATart's activities in our blog and take a look behind the scenes.

feeds.title: NFT Kunst Blog
feeds.description: This website tries to 'separate the wheat from the chaff' and show pearls of NFT art on the blog. The blog on this website mainly presents artists, their works, their visions and ideas.

feeds.title: Sige Nagels Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! This is Sige Nagels. The urge to create drives me. Creating coincides with pursuing our deepest dreams, translating and expressing our soul's language and connecting with the essence of life. Bound by no specific training or style, I turn abstract geometry and concepts into diversification of concrete shapes and colours.
